[ASSISTANT_SAID] Must-try dishes at Gwangjang Market include:  
1. Bindae-tteok: Pancake made with ground mung beans and vegetables.  
2. Mayak Kimbap: Bite-sized rice and seaweed rolls with various fillings.  
3. Tteokbokki: Spicy rice cakes served with fish cakes and vegetables.  
4. Yachae Mandu: Vegetarian dumplings filled with vegetables.  
5. Gimbap: Korean-style sushi with various fillings.  
6. Eomuk: Fish cake made of fish paste.  
7. Sundae: Traditional Korean sausage made with pig's intestines, noodles, and various ingredients.
